title: read_document
description: Read text, code, PDF content, or file metadata from a file on the local system.

path.description: Absolute path to the target file.

mode.description: The observation mode. 'text' and 'code' extract raw strings, 'pdf' attempts PDF extraction, and 'metadata' returns file statistics.

byte_range.description: Optional [start, end] byte range for partial reading of large files (applies to 'text' and 'code' modes).
